name: nexus-commerce
description: Nexus Commerce for Claude: the Nexus connector and the skills that use it, and the local factory connector.

plugins.name: nexus
plugins.description: Connects Claude to Nexus Commerce for one business per connection, and adds 18 skills: listings, content, ids, prices, stock, reorders, orders, returns, buyer messages, ads, automations, platform health, change plans and undo. Every change waits for a person's approval in Nexus unless the business set that change to run by its rule or to be confirmed with an authenticator code.

plugins.name: nexus-factory
plugins.description: Connects Claude on the factory machine to the Nexus factory app through its own local server, and adds the factory-desk skill: reads, and drafts the Owner finishes in the factory app. Needs a copy of the repository and a token from the factory's Settings › Integrations › Claude.
